title: pyproject declares no licence
description: pyproject.toml declares a pyproject that records no licence. Redistribution rights cannot be established from the packaging metadata, which blocks release review and downstream use.
remediation: Declare the licence (SPDX expression) or the licence file path.
limitation: It matches a pyproject that records no licence in the parsed pyproject.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
